(1) the LIGO data analysis pipeline can detect gravitational wave (GW) signals in the frequency range 100 - 1000 Hz in conjunction with GRB triggers; (2) the pipeline is capable of estimating the parameters of the GW signals (amplitude and phase) with a signal to noise ratio of 5; (3) the pipeline can be run on a personal computer and can be easily modified to search for other signals, such as those from supernovae;

we have developed a complete analysis pipeline that can be used to search for gravitational wave signals in real interferometric detectors in conjunction with astrophysical phenomena that have a well-defined time of occurrence.
